description: AdvanVis - Smart KPI and Scorecard shows KPI cards that say what changed and whether it matters. One visual holds a card for every measure, each with its trend, its target and status, the change on last year and a note in plain English. FREE FEATURES (no licence needed, no watermark) • A card for each measure in Values (up to 24), or for each value of a Cards by field • Figures that fit: three significant digits with the right unit, one size across the grid • Tiles or one row per KPI, picked to fit; order by data, name, biggest change or needs attention first; Top N cards • A Trend axis gives each card a sparkline (line, area or columns) and the change on the period before, as an amount or a % • Unfinished period: the last full period is the figure, and the unfinished one is drawn faded • Lower is better for costs, churn and delays: guessed from the name, set for all, or named one by one • Percentage measures change in points, never as a % of a % • Card style: background, border, rounded corners and a status bar; value colour by rule (fx) • Average and fixed lines on the sparkline (Analytics pane) • Cross-highlighting, cross-filtering by a card, drill-down, tooltips for the card and every sparkline point, Show condition • Basic headline, keyboard navigation, screen reader text and high contrast support PRO FEATURES (additional purchase may be required; one-month free trial…
